entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CSC and DevEnv crash with stack overflow when partial class with partial event implements interface #80986
  • "Generate method" does not add `static` modifier when generating method for function pointer #80984
  • "Introduce local" generates invalid code for function pointer types #80982
  • "Generate method" drops verbatim identifiers from value tuple names #80979

Closed

  • Syntax highlighting does not work properly on alias symbol for value tuple type #80981

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix "Generate method" to add static modifier for function pointers #80985
    VSCode
  • Fix "Introduce local" generating invalid code for function pointer types #80983
    VSCode
  • Fix: Preserve verbatim identifiers in tuple element names during code generation #80980
    VSCode

Updated

  • Fix VariablesDeclaredWalker with recursive patterns #80910
    Area-Compilers
  • Enable LSP go-to-definition, find-all-references, and go-to-implementation with command handler precedence #80951
  • Extensions: improve diagnostics for operators #80928
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
